title: Nine Hundred of Sugar
subtitle: 热量与营养 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 热量与营养（生活与学习·饮食与营养）
meta: 主题语境：热量与营养（生活与学习·饮食与营养）　|　核心词汇：calorie　|　正文 339 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 calorie 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1966 my mother was sent to count ① a calorie she could not see, and she said the seeing was the whole of the lesson. The ② calorie, meaning the unit and not the food, was nine hundred and was counted by whoever came last; a calorie, she said, is the only thing in a diet that is judged by how much has been taken out of it.

Every ③ calorie in that chart had the same column, and the ④ calorie at the end, meaning the one the nurse counted and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever counted properly. A calorie, my grandmother said, is nine parts arithmetic and one part somebody willing to stay behind; my mother said the arithmetic is the part that gets everywhere.

My father meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ calorie was the whole of the meal, meaning the food it measured and not the unit. The ⑥ calorie, meaning the food and not any of that, is the only thing in a clinic that everybody counts and nobody questions; a calorie, he said, is either something you count or the only word that means both a unit and a meal. She said the meal is the part they remember.

By 1979 the ⑦ calorie had become a number in a report, and the report had become an argument about the arithmetic. The ⑧ calorie of the whole thing, my mother wrote in April, was nine hundred and eleven years of counting; a calorie, she said, is either the one at the end or the reason you learned to stand on a chair. He said the chair was never mentioned.

The ⑨ calorie I remember is the one at the end, which was written in 1983 and is still described as the best in the county. A ⑩ calorie, my grandmother said in 1988, is the only thing that improves by being counted; every calorie, she said, is a meal that has agreed to look like a unit. She said the meal was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 卡路里；热量单位
B. n. 卡路里（指那个单位本身，与食物相对）
C. 固定搭配：count a calorie 数／计算卡路里
D. n. 卡路里（指表上每一项）
E. n. 卡路里（指末尾那一项）
F. n. 热量；食物（抽象：与那个单位相对）
G. n. 那顿饭（抽象：那件事本身）
H. n. 权衡；整件事的分量（抽象总称）

items.q: a calorie she could not see
The calorie, meaning the unit and not the food
calorie was the whole of the meal
the calorie had become a number in a report
The calorie of the whole thing
A calorie, my grandmother said in 1988

answers.why: count a calorie 意为“数／计算卡路里”，1966 年母亲被派去数一个她看不见的卡路里。
calorie 意为“卡路里”，指那个单位本身而不是食物，共九百，由最后走的人计算。
calorie 指表上每一项热量，每一项都在同一栏里。
calorie 指末尾那一项（护士数的那一项），是唯一有人认真计算过的。
calorie 意为“热量、食物”，与那个单位相对，父亲说 calorie 就是那顿饭的全部。
calorie 为抽象用法，指那顿饭本身，是诊所里人人都计算、却没人质疑的东西。
calorie 意为“卡路里、热量单位”，到 1979 年这个 calorie 成了报告里的一个数字。
calorie 意为“权衡、整件事的分量”，母亲四月写道，整件事权衡下来是九百卡和十一年的计算。
calorie 意为“卡路里”，我记得的是末尾那一项，1983 年写下，至今仍被说成全县最好的。
calorie 为抽象总称，祖母说卡路里是唯一会因为被认真计算而变好的东西。
